sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Material Capsule's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (com.pryshedko.mtisland.App).
Disables Google Analytics for Firebase measurement and switches off Firebase Analytics / Advertising-ID data collection via the official opt-out flags.

Forces the client-side Pro entitlement (custom colors, card/anim controls, full-size player, app search, widgets, gestures). Material Capsule's premium is a local flag derived from a Play purchase query and stored AES-encrypted on-device —…
Material Capsule ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.

sources.label: Free patches for Android apps (Morphe patch source). First app: Memorize Pi Digi
sources.author: Jo
patch_list: Disables the Play PairIP license check that forces a re-signed build to the Play Store on launch. Required for a sideloaded (non-root) install of the patched APK.

Deactivates Google Analytics for Firebase through the documented manifest switches, so no analytics event is uploaded, and removes the advertising-ID / Privacy-Sandbox permissions. No app feature is changed.

Forces the Pro/Premium entitlement to active, so every locked feature (gestures, widgets, card colours, full mode player, app search, ...) works without a Play purchase. The billing code is left untouched.
